items.title: Moderna Soared 8% on Cancer Data. Friday’s Report Shows Whether It Can Afford the Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna stock jumped 13% on Wednesday to a new 52-week high on early multiple myeloma data and an Ebola vaccine recommendation, then gave back 5% on Thursday ahead of Friday’s report. Pfizer’s Comirnaty sales fell 29% operationally in the third quarter, and BioNTech’s revenue fell 15%.

items.title: Are Your Dividends Safe? 4 Companies Whose Debt Is Competing With the Payout
items.summary: Bondholders get paid first, and shareholders get whatever the board leaves behind. Four high-yield stocks, from a hospital landlord to a telecom giant, are now squeezed between rising interest costs and the checks sent to investors. Which payout bends first?

items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Q3 Earnings Rebuild Confidence As New Drugs Gain Ground
items.summary: Pfizer just put Q3 2026 on the table and the first instinctive verdict from traders was a modest nod, with the stock up about 2.6% to roughly $30.80 after the release. Headlines are all about a clean return to profitability, with basic earnings per share at $0.57 on revenue of $16.6b, and an adjusted earnings beat that quickly caught the eye.
